guard: the seat command socket opens with its server and is removed when it exits, refuses readers it cannot serve with their causes, and settles every request it sent
why: S1 to S4 cut the socket's lifetime in mcp.ts: a seat or session that exits without closing leaves the file behind, and a Desktop server must open none.
S5 to S16 break the feed and the reader one rule at a time. The suites run dist/seat.cjs and dist/command-reader.cjs, so every mutation builds the package first and rebuilds after the restore.

mutations.cell: a managed seat removes the command socket when it exits
